messages:
Claire (PM): Kicking off a thread to finalize Dedicated PRD acceptance criteria, contract visibility, and rollback/runbook items. Need clean language for Sales and SRE.
Diego (SRE): Top priorities: define precise breach windows, autoscale latency targets for warm vs cold starts, and a clear degradation policy.
Ellen (Sales): Customers will ask about credits and failover. We need a compact contract clause: how credits are calculated and what triggers cross-routing to hosted fallback (opt-in only).
Marcus (Infra): Suggest we define 3 operational modes per contract: fail-fast (default low-latency), soft-queue (configurable Q depth), and hosted-fallback (opt-in). Include explicit config knobs and default values.
Claire (PM): Acceptance checklist proposal: 1) Perf lab: p95 under baseline+40% burst for 30m, 2) Canary: one paying customer run for 72h with real prompts, 3) Ops tabletop validated rollback steps.
Diego (SRE): Autoscale numeric targets: warm nodes: add 1.8x throughput within <=180s; cold nodes: reach 90% of steady throughput within <=10min. Define "warm" as model cache warmed and weights already staged.
Marcus (Infra): Hysteresis: scale-down delay 10m after sustained low usage; avoid flapping by requiring 2 consecutive windows.
QA Bot: Tests to include: KV cache eviction under long contexts, tenant noisy-burst isolation, preemption/instance termination, network partition. Pass criteria: p95 regression <30% vs baseline for lab tests.
Ellen (Sales): Credits model suggestion: prorated credits up to monthly cap 50% of committed fee; formula base on minutes of downtime below 99.5% SLA. Legal to confirm language.
Diego (SRE): Rollback triggers: automated partial rollback if p95 > 2x baseline for 5m OR sustained OOMs; full rollback if after 15m no improvement. Manual abort must be available.
Claire (PM): Degradation behavior: if available capacity <95% of committed, system should notify customer and apply configured burst policy. If capacity <85% escalate to failover/queue per contract.
Marcus (Infra): Soft-queue defaults: Q=200 requests, per-request TTL 10s. For fail-fast mode, return 429 with informative header indicating reason and retry-after.
Diego (SRE): Observability must include per-route p95/p99, queue depth, retry counts, time-to-scale metric, and cost delta when fallback used. Dashboards and saved queries linked in PRD.
Claire (PM): Acceptance-run phases: unit -> perf-lab -> canary (1 customer) -> private preview (3 customers) -> GA. Each gate needs a go/no-go signoff with checklist.
Ellen (Sales): I'll draft contract snippets for credits, queue-mode opt-in, and hosted-fallback opt-in and share by EOD.
QA Bot: Schedule chaos runs after perf lab but before canary. Submit results and raw traces to PRD.
Diego (SRE): I'll author the rollback playbook and incident runbook. Include scripts to force partial rollback and verify canary metrics.
Marcus (Infra): I'll add configuration knobs in infra for soft-queue, fallback routing, and hysteresis windows.
Claire (PM): Action items summarized: Claire update PRD with acceptance checklist and degradation rules; Diego draft ops/runbook; Marcus implement config flags; Ellen draft contract language; QA Bot schedule tests. Aim to freeze PRD for review by next Wed.
Jenkins: Reminder: canary rollout automation will gate on 30m stable p95 and queue-depth thresholds.
